name: Blood Hunt
story: Hunters wait at the only well on this stretch of road.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Three hunters sit around a well. Their vessels are full, but they will not move aside.

beforeStory.speaker: Hunter
beforeStory.text: We keep what we have. Find your own water.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith fills the waterskin. This time he wipes its mouth before handing it to Mara.

name: Twin Bell Chamber
story: The bells sound almost like something Mara remembers.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: That sound... I used to stand up when I heard it.

beforeStory.speaker: Bellkeeper
beforeStory.text: Then stand. They may be coming.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: A boat. I think it was a boat arriving. I remember standing. That is all I have.

name: Retaliation Idols
story: The idols return every blow. Mara asks Arith to slow down.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: A blow against an idol comes back across the passage. Mara catches Arith by the sleeve.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Wait. Do not rush another attack.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith holds out the waterskin. Mara lets go of his sleeve.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: Sorry. Let us stop before we try the next door.

name: The Blood Bell
story: The Matriarch checks every empty chair before ringing the bell.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: A long table stands beneath the bell. The Matriarch straightens a chair, checks its place, and reaches for the rope.

beforeStory.speaker: Bell Matriarch
beforeStory.text: Are you going to wait for someone, or to take a boat?

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I remember a seat beside me. I wiped it dry.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: I waited at a ferry. I do not remember whether anyone came.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The Matriarch reaches for another chair. They leave while she is still deciding where to put it.
